verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
All-consuming fire
You're our heart's desire
Living flame of love
Come baptize us, come baptize us

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Let us fall more in love with You
Let us fall more in love with You
Let us fall more in love with You
Let us fall more in love with You

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
We want to know
How high, how deep, how wide is
Love, love, love
We want to know
How high, how deep, how wide is
Love, love, love
